setup_image_classification_task: setup an ImageClassificationTask instance from an ImageClassificationConfig dataclass for fairseq image classification
load_image_classification_dataset: load a train or validation image dataset with augmentation transforms for image classification splits
build_image_classification_model: build a model for image classification by extending the pretraining task and propagating pretrained model args
reduce_classification_metrics: reduce logging outputs to compute and log accuracy metrics for image classification evaluation
review_image_classification_task: review the ImageClassificationTask class and its dataset loading, model building, and metrics reduction methods
